sections.heading: C2 — Attention and alertness confusables
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Attention and alertness confusables with knowledge-graph hints

FACT_ID: sec07-R01 | anchor: A29
Eyes off road and hands off wheel show openly, but mind off road hides inside, gazing straight past hazards it never sees. [A29]
Why it matters: group_hint distraction-kinds; prereq_hint sec07-F01; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec07-F01, sec07-F06.
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0029]
FACT_ID: sec07-R02 | anchor: A29
Cabin traps are phones, dials, screens, grooming, riders, meals and maps, while roadside traps are gawk scenes, sun, debris, zones and billboards. [A29]
Why it matters: group_hint lure-lists; prereq_hint sec07-F02; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec07-F02, sec07-F03.
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0029]
FACT_ID: sec07-R03 | anchor: A29
Self defense presets controls, parks meals and maps, belts and crates the cabin, while other defense reads drifts, surges, fiddles and fights. [A29]
Why it matters: group_hint self-vs-other; prereq_hint sec07-F04; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec07-F04, sec07-F05.
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0029]
FACT_ID: sec07-R04 | anchor: A29
Distracted leaders earn three to four seconds of room and extra wary passes, since unaware drifters can slide across without warning. [A29]
Why it matters: group_hint follow-distracted; prereq_hint sec07-F05; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec07-F05.
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0029]
FACT_ID: sec07-R05 | anchor: A29
The wheel holder owns the whole cabin legally, so crash fault lands on the distracted driver and never on the distraction itself. [A29]
Why it matters: group_hint sole-blame; prereq_hint sec07-F06; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec07-F06.
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0029]
FACT_ID: sec07-R06 | anchor: A30
People sixteen to twenty-four often need more sleep than average adults, untreated obstructive sleep apnea raises the risk of falling asleep at the wheel seven times, working the night shift raises that risk by nearly six times, and rotating-shift or over-sixty-hour weekly workers must be particularly careful [A30].
Why it matters: group_hint risk-groups; prereq_hint sec07-F08; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec07-F08.
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0030]
FACT_ID: sec07-R07 | anchor: A30
Trip prep banks seven to nine sleep hours with hundred mile or two hour pauses, plus a relief rider and no drowsy pills or drinks. [A30]
Why it matters: group_hint pre-trip; prereq_hint sec07-F09; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec07-F09.
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0030]
FACT_ID: sec07-R08 | anchor: A30
Body alarms are lid droops, yawns, drifts, missed exits, daydreams and dullness, and their answer is stopping to sleep, never pressing on. [A30]
Why it matters: group_hint signs-vs-cure; prereq_hint sec07-F10; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec07-F10, sec07-F11.
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0030]
FACT_ID: sec07-R09 | anchor: A30
Short naps of fifteen to twenty minutes pair with two coffee equivalents taken first, yet caffeine fades, midnight to six stays cursed, and only sleep truly restores. [A30]
Why it matters: group_hint nap-caffeine; prereq_hint sec07-F11; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec07-F11.
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0030]
FACT_ID: sec07-R10 | anchor: A30
Running over a shoulder rumble strip requires pulling off at a safe place immediately to check alertness; when unwell, let someone else drive; avoid alcohol and sedating medications by checking labels or asking your doctor; and when strong emotions affect driving, cool off off-road, leave extra time, or let someone else drive [A30].
Why it matters: group_hint stop-vs-swap; prereq_hint sec07-F12; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec07-F12, sec07-F13, sec07-F14.
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-ct-d:connecticut-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0030]
